gcrosshair_core89 ABI3 outline validation

Compiler flags:
  -O2 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror

Passed:
  test_core
    - original four-arm cross
    - center placement
    - dot and image hybrid path
    - scale animation

  test_abi3_shapes
    - GC89_TYPES_ABI_VERSION == 3
    - GC89_CORE_ABI_VERSION == 3
    - all eight shape families emit vector primitives
    - segment/direction fields, rotation and break values exercised

  test_outline
    - outline geometry emits before normal geometry
    - line thickness adds two times the requested border width
    - center-dot diameter adds two times the requested border width
    - independent outline and normal colors preserved

  cross-library integration smoke test
    - gcrosshair_base89 constructs a real preset
    - gcrosshair_params89 resolves ABI 3 outline fields
    - gcrosshair_core89 emits outline and normal primitives

Constraints retained:
  C89; fixed point; no malloc/realloc/free; no float/double; no renderer dependency.
